lines.text: [curious] This taco truck... had no name. [pause] No logo. [sighs] Nothing.
[mischievously] So I gave Claude... one sentence.
[excited] And it built the ENTIRE brand!
[building excitement] A logo. Colors that feel like fire! A menu. Cups. Bags. [amazed] A website.
[whispers] Every piece of this... came from one prompt.
[warmly] Want it for your business? [playfully] Follow me, and comment PROMPT. I'll send it to your DMs.
[urgently] The first fifty get it free. [seriously] After that... it's paid.
